properties.description: Registers reflow2 with the user's agent at USER scope, so no project ever needs setting up: the MCP server (Claude Code via `claude mcp add -s user`, OpenCode via its user config), the ten slash commands into `~/.claude/commands/`, the coherence-loop hooks into `~/.claude/settings.json`, and a `reflow2` command on PATH whose subcommands are `install`, `init` and `check`. Idempotent and merge-only — it never overwrites a config it did not write, reports every file it left alone and why, has `--check` and `--uninstall`, and refuses to report success when a step failed. Run by `install.sh` automatically, so the release one-liner is the whole install for any user.
properties.name: Install reflow2 once for every project on a machine
